title: The Training Dojo
hints: The shape is: something before the loop that the condition looks at, and something inside the loop that changes it. `while (level < 5) { ... }` needs `level` to grow inside, or it never stops.
Count the sessions with a variable you declare BEFORE the loop and `++` at the top of each pass. If you declare it inside, it is reborn every time.
The level-up is an `if` INSIDE the while loop, checked after adding xp: `if (xp >= 100) { xp -= 100; ++level; ... }`.
Subtract 100, do not reset to 0 - the leftover xp carries over. That is why the totals after a level-up are 20, then 10, then 0, then 20.
